title: Tiia
body:
Lately the app has stopped working: mostly I cannot access any of my notes, and if I can, there's a major lag or I'm unable to edit. The latest software updates have not resolved the issue. I cannot enable the background refresh in the app settings. I also have the latest iOS and have reinstalled the app and restarted my phone multiple times. I have ca. 15 active notes of which one has an image attached. So no use blaming me not archiving notes either.

Google Keep seems to be completely useless, since this issue still persists.
